acceptanceCriteria: A change touching only task, review and BUGS records owes no test kinds
A code change still owes its test kinds, and config.json still widens to architecture
diagnosis: Reproduced: testKindsReal over .codictator/tasks and .codictator/reviews json files for a feature task reports missing acceptance and unit tests. Root cause: scenarioChanges sets isDoc only for .md paths, so Codictator record JSON counts as code and requiredTestKinds demands tests (SPEC 4.10.3 exempts docs and records). Fix: classify .codictator/tasks and .codictator/reviews json as non-code in scenarioChanges; config.json stays code.
